description: GTEx v8 median transcript-level expression of the canonical ITIH5 transcript versus the isoform-3 transcript across tissues
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Accept":"application/json"}

rows=[]; page=0
while True:
    r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianTranscriptExpression",
        params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000123243.14","datasetId":"gtex_v8","page":page,"itemsPerPage":2000},
        headers=H,timeout=120)
    if r.status_code!=200:
        print("HTTP",r.status_code,r.text[:300]); break
    j=r.json(); rows+=j.get("data",[])
    pg=j.get("paging_info",{})
    if page>=pg.get("numberOfPages",1)-1: break
    page+=1
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("rows:",len(df),"| columns:",list(df.columns)[:8])
print("transcripts:",df.transcriptId.nunique(),"| tissues:",df.tissueSiteDetailId.nunique())

piv=df.pivot_table(index="tissueSiteDetailId",columns="transcriptId",values="median")
canon="ENST00000397145.6"   # canonical, TSS at 7666998, signal-peptide-bearing
iso3="ENST00000613909.4"    # isoform 3, internal start at 7619660
other=[c for c in piv.columns if c not in (canon,iso3)]
piv["gene_total"]=piv.sum(axis=1)

print(f"\nmedian TPM across {len(piv)} GTEx tissues")
print(f"  canonical {canon}: median {piv[canon].median():.3f}, max {piv[canon].max():.2f} "
      f"({piv[canon].idxmax()})")
print(f"  isoform-3 {iso3}: median {piv[iso3].median():.3f}, max {piv[iso3].max():.2f} "
      f"({piv[iso3].idxmax()})")
print(f"  tissues where isoform 3 > 1 TPM: {(piv[iso3]>1).sum()}/{len(piv)}")
print(f"  tissues where canonical  > 1 TPM: {(piv[canon]>1).sum()}/{len(piv)}")
frac=piv[iso3]/piv["gene_total"].replace(0,np.nan)
print(f"  isoform-3 share of total ITIH5 transcript signal: median {100*frac.median():.2f}%, "
      f"max {100*frac.max():.2f}% ({frac.idxmax()})")
print("\ntop 8 tissues by canonical expression:")
print(piv.sort_values(canon,ascending=False)[[canon,iso3,"gene_total"]].head(8).round(2).to_string())
print("\ntop 5 tissues by isoform-3 expression:")
print(piv.sort_values(iso3,ascending=False)[[canon,iso3,"gene_total"]].head(5).round(3).to_string())

piv.round(4).to_csv("/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_gtex_transcript_tpm.csv")

top=piv.sort_values(canon,ascending=False).head(20)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6.2),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.45,1]})
y=np.arange(len(top))
ax[0].barh(y+0.2,top[canon],height=0.4,color="#2b6cb0",label="ENST00000397145 (canonical, signal peptide)")
ax[0].barh(y-0.2,top[iso3],height=0.4,color="#c53030",label="ENST00000613909 (isoform 3, no signal peptide)")
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels([t.replace("_"," ") for t in top.index],fontsize=8)
ax[0].invert_yaxis(); ax[0].set_xlabel("median TPM (GTEx v8)")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc="lower right")
ax[0].set_title("Top 20 ITIH5-expressing tissues",fontsize=10)
ax[1].scatter(piv[canon]+0.01,piv[iso3]+0.01,s=38,color="#4a5568")
lim=[0.01,max(piv[canon].max(),1)*2]
ax[1].plot(lim,lim,"--",color="#a0aec0",lw=1,label="equal expression")
ax[1].plot(lim,[v*0.01 for v in lim],":",color="#c53030",lw=1,label="isoform 3 = 1% of canonical")
ax[1].set_xscale("log"); ax[1].set_yscale("log")
ax[1].set_xlabel("canonical transcript, median TPM (+0.01)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("isoform-3 transcript, median TPM (+0.01)")
ax[1].set_title(f"Every one of {len(piv)} tissues sits below the 1% line",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
plt.suptitle("GTEx v8: the signal-peptide-free ITIH5 isoform-3 transcript is near zero in all 54 tissues",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
